notes:
-- Account background: Codestream Ops builds an IDE-integrated copilot optimized for large monorepos and polyglot stacks (Java, TS, Python, Go). Target customers are mid-large engineering teams that want local-like completions.
-- Stage: Demo POC active. In-editor demo on 2026-02-02 (ff_2026-02-02_codestream-poc-kickoff). Sec review 2026-02-24 (ff_2026-02-24_security-q&a).
-- Primary asks / success metrics (customer phrasing):
   • Streaming latency: median token push <=60ms; p95 <=150ms for small completions inside VSCode.
   • Concurrency: support 1k concurrent editor sessions in pilot, burst to 3k.
   • Context window: want repo-aware retrieval that returns function-level + nearby-file context, preserve import graph hints.
   • Corpus: ~40M LOC across ~300k files; they want chunking that avoids breaking small functions and preserves docstrings/comments for search.
   • Retrieval: embeddings + vector DB. Evaluating RedisVector, Milvus, Weaviate; asking for recommended shard/replica topology for sub-50ms cold lookup in na/eu.
   • Embedding cadence: incremental on push to main + nightly full reindex; plan for checkpointed embedding versions to support model-pin rollback.
   • Recall target: recall@10 >= 0.88 on their internal queries; precision/quality important to avoid noisy suggestions.
   • Model/version policy: must support pinning to a specific model version per release channel (stable/canary). Rollback within 15 minutes. Fallback to quantized smaller model under capacity pressure.
-- Integration notes: prefer private VPC for customers with code residency needs; for some enterprise customers require on-prem agent (air-gapped). Need KMS for key separation and audit logs for dev activity. SAML required for SSO. SOC2 in place; ISO27001 requested by a couple of pilots.
-- POC scope (2-week in-editor streaming focus):
   Week 0: onboarding + repo sync (sample subset, 5M LOC).
   Week 1: embed pipeline + index; baseline retrieval latency/recall measurement.
   Week 2: streaming tuning, model-pin tests, canary rollout simulation, UX feedback loop.
   Deliverables: ingestion runbook, chunking sample (Python/Go), vector DB topology doc, streaming perf report.
-- Commercial intent: leaning Dedicated for pilot, long-term Private for regulated customers; ARR expected in $80k-$220k band.
-- Quotes / snippets: "We need suggestions that feel like they were written inside our codebase, not generic." -- Sr. Product.
-- Action items: SE (Jules) to send sample chunker + vector topology; Product to validate model pin rollback SLA; Legal to confirm EU residency controls; schedule SAML test window.
-- Blockers (details): legal wants explicit retention windows per repo; air-gapped packaging spec still WIP; CI preprocessor required for repo to generate embedding-ready chunks (customer asked for reference code).
